description: Topic Universe for Me / Vibe Content Factory. User interests personalize recommendations but do not constrain the whole content library.

source_basis.extension_note: Podcast and Music pools are Vibe Content Factory extensions beyond the older Text/Image/Video-only v2 media contract.

feed_strategy_defaults.note: Initial recommendation weights only; not hard content quotas.

interest.rule: Exactly 100 seeds for each of the 8 official Planning interests.

discovery.rule: Interesting general topics independent of user-selected interests.

podcast.rule: Audio-first themes; not forced under Planning interests.

music.rule: Genre + mood + activity seeds; intentionally independent of food/travel/etc.

character_matching.binding_rule: Preserve fixed character mappings. Match generic content later at publish-queue time.
